summary: Make JSONStorage write keys sorted by default so committed db.json fixtures stop producing noisy diffs, while keeping an option to turn sorting off.
narrative: The owner asked for JSONStorage to write sorted keys by default because committed db.json fixtures in their service repo showed noisy diffs when key order changed. They also wanted sorting to stay optional. Memory holds only this opening ask and no observations, so there is no recorded implementation, PR or release yet. The request is at the very start.

milestones.text: Owner asked for sorted-key JSONStorage output by default, with an opt-out, to reduce noisy db.json fixture diffs.

preferences.preference: Wants sensible defaults that reduce noise, but with an opt-out to preserve flexibility.
preferences.quote: Can you make JSONStorage write keys sorted by default? Should still be possible to turn it off.
